answers.rationale: award_remaining_balance records award A-101 with award_amount 50000, disbursed_total 35000, and remaining_balance 15000.
award_match_obligation for A-102 (program SEED-FAST) records match_required as no and match_rate as 0; no cash match is required.
Award A-101 is linked to org_id ORG-MEADOW, which organization identifies as Meadow Community Trust. The only other award for that organization is A-103.

A-101 is in program SEED-CORE, where cash match may be waived if a written waiver is on file. The packet does not include waiver letters, so the match obligation cannot be established confidently despite award_match_obligation listing match_required yes at rate 0.20.
Award A-104 carries status_code S, but status_legend_entry only defines codes A (Active) and C (Closed). S is not listed in the office legend, so its meaning cannot be interpreted.

Only awards with an established Active status via award_status_label are A-101 (remaining_balance 15000) and A-102 (remaining_balance 0). Awards with uninterpreted status codes (A-104, A-105) and Closed status (A-103) are excluded. Total: 15000 + 0 = 15000.
